item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders about perspective, projecting, and mind reading. That tells me you already know the pattern: the mind fills gaps with stories. Today, when a tense thought shows up, separate what you actually know from what you're assuming. Facts only. Then choose your response on purpose. Action: at midday, pause, name one assumption you're making, and write down the fact beneath it.
